alt: 原本藏在桌下的作弊答案被老師發現，偷偷作弊的人看到證據曝光，頓時慌了。
scene_prompt: 東窗事發 means a concealed dishonest scheme has been exposed. Modern classroom after an exam. A teacher has just found a hidden answer sheet tucked beneath a student's desk and holds it beside the student's matching test sheet, revealing the cheating. Both papers contain ONLY identical simple geometric diagrams, no readable letters or numerals. The dishonest older teen looks startled and embarrassed at the exposed evidence, while a classmate looks surprised; teacher calm, no humiliation, punishment or anger. A slightly open desk drawer and previously concealed paper location make secrecy then discovery clear. No police, prison, real school branding or text.
